name: Cross-Session Context Engine
description: Unified context storage and retrieval across agent sessions

storeDir.description: Path to the JSONL context store directory. Default: ~/.openclaw/context-store

maxEntries.description: Maximum entries per agent before cleanup. Default: 5000

retrievalTopK.description: Max entries returned during assembly. Default: 10

decayHalfLife.description: Time decay half-life for retrieval ranking. Default: 7d
